name: refactoring
description: Refactoring workflow with test safety: capture test baseline, plan, incremental refactoring with verification, regression testing, code review, and completion.

steps.name: test-baseline
steps.description: Run tests on default branch, capture baseline snapshot before any changes
steps.start:
Capture the test baseline BEFORE any refactoring work. This must run on the default branch (main/master) to establish the true starting point.

1. Identify the project's test command (e.g., pytest -v, npm test, go test ./..., cargo test).
2. Run the test suite and record the results.
3. Note: pre-existing failures are acceptable — they will be tracked in the baseline so they aren't confused with regressions later.
4. If there is NO test suite: consider whether tests should be written first. If the refactoring is safe without tests, pass test_command="none" and baseline_summary="No test suite found".

When the test run is complete, call protocol_advance with args:
{"test_command": "<the exact command>", "baseline_summary": "<e.g. 47 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped>"}
steps.end: Test baseline captured. You have the exact test command and a summary of results (passes, failures, skips). Pass args: {"test_command": "<command>", "baseline_summary": "<summary>"} to protocol_advance.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Define refactoring scope, create task, setup branch
steps.end: Refactoring scope is defined with clear success criteria. User has explicitly approved the plan. Task file content composed following TEMPLATE.md format. Pass args: {"task": "<priority>-refactor-<name>", "branch": "feature/<name>", "task_content": "<full markdown>"} to protocol_advance.

steps.name: refactoring
steps.description: Incremental refactoring with mandatory inter-increment testing
steps.end: All refactoring changes are complete. Each increment was tested and passed. Success criteria from the task file are checked off. Ready for full regression verification.

steps.name: test-verify
steps.end: All previously-passing tests still pass. No regressions introduced. Verification results summarized for the user. If regressions were found, they have been fixed (via protocol_goto to refactoring step) and re-verified.

steps.name: code-review
steps.description: Spec compliance review + code quality review. Sentinel SPEC_REVIEW: PASSED required before advance. Summary must evidence verification. verify_tests_pass deliberately omitted: the refactoring protocol tolerates pre-existing baseline failures (test-verify step diffs against the baseline), while verify_tests_pass requires exit 0 and would permanently block dirty-baseline codebases.
steps.end: Code review passes with zero critical issues. If warning enforcement is strict (enforce_warnings=true), zero warnings required — fix all warnings and re-review until clean. If relaxed (enforce_warnings=false or not set), warnings are documented but do not block. Final passing review results are appended to the task work log in the exact format: '# Code Review: [Title]' with Summary, Critical Issues, Warnings, and Notes sections.

steps.name: completion
steps.description: User tests changes, confirms, then dispatcher runs the provider-driven chain or the 4-option menu flow when issue tracking is disabled.
steps.end: User has tested the changes and explicitly confirmed everything works correctly. Upon calling protocol_advance, the engine automatically handles: committing and pushing changes, creating MR/PR (if provider enabled), updating issue status, archiving task file, cleaning up test baseline and task-scoped state, and clearing task state. When issue_tracking.provider is 'disabled', the user picks a completion_option from the menu presented on step entry (merge_local / push_pr / keep / discard).
